source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
As either player's Fight phase starts, pick 1 enemy unit no more than 6" from this model. Until the phase ends:

- melee attacks by friendly **SLAANESH LEGIONES DAEMONICA** models that target that unit get +1 to Wound rolls
- melee attacks by models in that enemy unit get -1 to Wound rolls
